summary: Iteration 5 frontend validation of three iter4 fixes. RESULTS: (1) Territorial Internacional tab — overlay no longer appears ✓ (stopReportingRuntimeErrors did suppress react-error-overlay there). (2) Admin DIVIPOLA tab — STILL CRASHES; the previous white-screen bug is NOT fixed. Clicking the DIVIPOLA tab causes webpack-dev-server overlay iframe to appear AND the entire React tree to unmount (document.body innerText drops to 18 chars 'Made with Emergent'). All DIVIPOLA controls (search, country filter, Excel button, Nuevo municipio button) are missing. The ErrorBoundary wrappers around each TabsContent do NOT catch this error because it originates in a passive useEffect cleanup (destroy is not a function) which React does not deliver to ErrorBoundary in the current configuration. (3) Executive/Caracterización/Académico headers — 3 export buttons all present (xlsx, csv, students) ✓. Backend smoke skipped per request (already validated iter4).

ui_bugs.issue: DIVIPOLA tab still produces a white screen / blank app on click. Body innerText after click = 'Made with Emergent' (18 chars) — entire React root unmounts, not just DivipolaTab. The `webpack-dev-server-client-overlay` iframe appears, indicating a crash. Repro: login → /admin → click [data-testid='tab-divipola']. ErrorBoundary wrapping (Admin.jsx l.43) does NOT catch the failure because the error originates in passive useEffect cleanup (destroy-is-not-a-function pattern) during the tab transition, which React does not propagate to error boundaries before crashing the root. Iteration-4 fixes (defensive paises filter, per-tab ErrorBoundary) are in place but ineffective for this class of error.

stopReportingRuntimeErrors() suppresses react-error-overlay on the Territorial page (verified clean), BUT does NOT suppress the CRA/webpack 5 dev-server overlay iframe `#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay`. That overlay still renders on the Admin DIVIPOLA crash. Two different overlay systems exist in CRA dev — only react-error-overlay was disabled.

integration_issues.issue: Search, country filter, Excel export, Nuevo municipio dialog cannot be exercised because DivipolaTab does not render at all.

action_items: ROOT CAUSE: A useEffect somewhere returns a Promise (likely `() => fetchData()` or `useEffect(fn, [])` where fn ends with `api.get().then()` returning the Promise) — React 18 then tries to call that Promise as a destroy fn → 'destroy is not a function' during unmount. ErrorBoundary cannot catch passive-effect cleanup errors. Hunt the offending useEffect. Suspect targets to inspect: (a) any leaflet/recharts wrapper in Territorial that unmounts when leaving the page (b) UsersTab/CatalogTab/DocenteMateriaTab in Admin.jsx l.56,149,235,323 — `useEffect(load, [])` where `load` is the function reference; if any `load` is an `async () => ...` arrow, it returns a Promise and breaks. Search: `grep -rn 'useEffect(.*async' src/` returns 0 hits, BUT `useEffect(load, [])` passes the function by reference — if `load` is `async`, this is identical to `useEffect(async () => ..., [])`. Verify each `load` declared in Admin.jsx is NOT async-arrow. /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx line 235 `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` is safe; lines 56 and 323 use `useEffect(load, [])` — confirm those `load` functions are synchronous block-arrows (currently they look safe).

Disable webpack-dev-server-client-overlay too. Add to /app/frontend/.env: `WDS_SOCKET_HOST=127.0.0.1` is NOT enough. Either (a) set `FAST_REFRESH=false` + `CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true` + patch webpack-dev-server config to `client: { overlay: false }` via craco/customize-cra/react-app-rewired, OR (b) globally monkey-patch in suppress-leaflet-errors.js to remove the iframe whenever it is inserted: `new MutationObserver(...).observe(document.body, {childList:true})` and remove `#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay`. Quick fix snippet: `new MutationObserver(() => { document.getElementById('webpack-dev-server-client-overlay')?.remove(); }).observe(document.body, {childList:true,subtree:true});`

Wrap entire <Admin /> route in a top-level ErrorBoundary (in App.jsx routes) so even if a passive unmount error escapes, the rest of the SPA shell survives. Currently the WHOLE app blanks to 18 chars.

Consider downgrading Leaflet effect cleanups or migrating away from problematic useEffect patterns — track the originating component (the stack in iter4 screenshot points to bundle.js commitHookEffectListUnmount → react-leaflet container cleanup).
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx l.43 wraps DivipolaTab in ErrorBoundary but error boundaries DO NOT catch errors thrown during passive effect cleanup in React 18 — they only catch render/lifecycle errors. This fix is architecturally insufficient.
suppress-leaflet-errors.js only handles react-error-overlay package; CRA 5 uses webpack-dev-server's own overlay (#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) which is independent and still fires.
Admin.jsx DivipolaTab paises filter `paises.filter((p) => p?.pais && p.pais.trim() !== '')` (l.411) is correctly defensive — good.
Executive.jsx l.31-37 — 3 export buttons all present with correct data-testids — good.

Other admin tabs (Users, Facultades, Programas, etc.) need to be tested to see whether the crash is exclusive to DIVIPOLA or affects any tab transition. Executive/Caracterización/Académico headers correctly expose data-testid='export-{scope}-xlsx|csv|students'. Backend was validated 100% in iter4; no need to retest until DIVIPOLA frontend bug is resolved. Suggested next step: open browser DevTools manually on /admin, click DIVIPOLA, inspect the React error stack inside the webpack overlay iframe to pinpoint the exact component/useEffect responsible for the destroy-is-not-a-function — that single fix likely unblocks both the overlay and the white-screen.
rca of the issue: Real root cause is a useEffect somewhere in the render path of DivipolaTab (or in a sibling tab being unmounted during the transition to DIVIPOLA) whose callback either returns a Promise or where the cleanup return value is not a function. In React 18 strict-mode / dev, this raises 'destroy is not a function' during the commit phase's passive unmount, which (a) cannot be caught by ErrorBoundary and (b) terminates the root render. The webpack-dev-server overlay then renders. Iter-4/5 mitigations (ErrorBoundary, defensive paises filter, stopReportingRuntimeErrors) do not fix the underlying bug — they only address symptoms or the wrong overlay. Mitigation requires either (1) finding and fixing the offending useEffect (most likely in a Leaflet / react-leaflet useEffect cleanup or in one of the Admin tab `load` helpers), or (2) suppressing the webpack-dev-server overlay via MutationObserver removing #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay AND adding a top-level ErrorBoundary at the route level so the rest of the SPA survives.
